limitations.text: Warehouse inventory not performed. (1) No labelled training examples for the AOI (get_examples returned 0). (2) imagery_window refused: the task has no imagery source, so no building can be visually confirmed. (3) zero_shot_text retrieval is not configured; vision_subagent needs GSI aerial photos (Japan only) and is irrelevant here. (4) The only embedding index (aef-10m-annual, 160 m cells, 3920 cells) is flagged synthetic (pooled fixture, not real AlphaEarth). Without examples or imagery, any ranking would be unsupported guesswork, so I did not report candidate points. Count: 0 confirmed, range unknown (not estimable from available data). The whole AOI (~10x9 km) is unreviewed. 10 m data would in any case struggle to separate warehouses from factories/markets.

understanding.goal_restated: Find warehouses (>=~1600 m2 logistics/storage buildings) in AOI near Chittagong (91.78-91.88E, 22.28-22.36N), report points with a count range and explicit gaps.
known_limits: 10 m resolution barely resolves 40 m buildings; warehouses hard to distinguish from factories/markets; no complete reference.
understanding.scope: AOI ~10x9 km; year 2024; embeddings plus Sentinel-2 (10 m) imagery for verification.
